release.rationale: User judges that concrete inconvenience remains compared with alternatives and permits bounded technical assessment of this previously automatically selected candidate. Target is less manual reduction, not an absolute zero-wiping requirement.

claims.statement: Existing molded wiping systems and stock lip applicators provide a plausible package-first development direction.
claims.material_or_component: Wiper, tip and stem; existing molded/flocked components
claims.conditions: Supplier specifications, not an empirical matched trial.
claims.applicability: Directly addresses the observed repeated excess-removal action while initially holding the intended formula constant.
claims.limits: No achieved reduction, reliable dose or compatibility is demonstrated.

claims.statement: Evaluate tip, wiper and formula together; a smaller tip alone is not a demonstrated solution.
claims.material_or_component: Tip surface/reservoir, wiping contact and product rheology
claims.conditions: Commercial qualitative viscosity classes and patent mechanisms; actual fill state and withdrawal handling unknown.
claims.applicability: Can motivate a bounded comparison of existing component combinations.
claims.limits: Smaller loading may trade manual wiping for extra dipping, patchy coverage or force; proposed variables are hypotheses.

claims.statement: Track withdrawal force and end droplets alongside loaded mass.
claims.conditions: Patent descriptions, with mascara examples for some force discussions.
claims.applicability: An agent-proposed secondary failure mode for a package revision.
claims.limits: No quantitative lip-force limit or patented geometry is adopted as a design requirement.

claims.statement: Separate base-dose control from gloss-brush cleaning in the proposed case.
claims.conditions: Supplier offers two reservoirs; consumer source evidence records cleaning as a distinct action.
claims.applicability: Preserve the two-step option without claiming reservoir separation solves brush contamination.
claims.limits: A wiping-friendly gloss tip is a separate hypothesis and not established by this supplier claim.

claims.statement: Preserve film/finish behavior while testing packaging; changing formula can introduce different wear/comfort trade-offs.
claims.conditions: Abstract-only primary research on another formulation with a novel resin.
claims.applicability: Motivates endpoints and controls, with no direct formulation recommendation.
claims.limits: No current-product composition, concentration, process or human performance inferred; published effects remain specific to that study.

claims.statement: Commercial silicone film-former families exist; preserve or assess an established suitable base formula before introducing a new material.
claims.material_or_component: Existing silicone-resin film-former family and carrier; no chosen concentration
claims.conditions: Supplier role statement and abstract-only mechanism/trade-off evidence on a different formulation.
claims.applicability: Provides a concrete existing-ingredient direction for the conditional brief while package loading remains the primary lever.
claims.limits: No finished-product performance or safe/compatible concentration inferred. The study-specific novel resin is excluded; the cited commercial listing is not a purchasing recommendation or adopted formula.

proposed_tests.objective: Reduce repeated manual excess removal without replacing it with extra dipping or poor coverage.
proposed_tests.control: Same existing formula and defined fill/handling conditions in the baseline and candidate package; compare an acceptable existing alternative separately.
proposed_tests.measure: Record load per withdrawal, mass manually removed, wipe/dip counts, end droplets and standardized coating uniformity. Use exploratory repeated loading before choosing a powered design.
proposed_tests.limitations: No test performed or equipment assumed. Resolution/evaporation correction and acceptance targets must be set before mass claims; bench coating does not prove user satisfaction.

proposed_tests.objective: Check that easier loading preserves the intended thin-layer result.
proposed_tests.control: Baseline formula/package and candidate package at matched applied amount; include the ordinary instructed routine for the existing alternative.
proposed_tests.measure: Record coating appearance, drying, transfer/rub behavior and gloss-overcoat interaction with stated substrate, load and time. Human wear/comfort would require a separately scoped later assessment.
proposed_tests.limitations: No numerical performance claim or safety conclusion. Abstract-only research provides endpoints, not a reproduced protocol or validated threshold.

proposed_tests.objective: Identify material, seal, flock and handling defects before selecting a package.
proposed_tests.control: Same formula, storage conditions and fill state, with baseline closure and existing material options.
proposed_tests.measure: Observe leaks, closure/withdrawal force, material/adhesive changes, fiber loss, product loss and loading drift over repeat use under a later qualified protocol.
proposed_tests.limitations: No stability, preservation, safety or regulatory acceptance established. Actual formula/solvent data and package specification are required; no purchasing or partner is assumed.

disposition.conclusion: Package-first assessment using established wiper/tip/stock-pack options is technically plausible enough for a conditional brief. This does not validate a finished formula or resolve the remaining alternatives evidence.
disposition.next: Consume in #325, preserve user intervention and comparison unknowns, then obtain the separate #327 usefulness evaluation.
unknowns: Actual current formula rheology, current package geometry and material compatibility.
Acceptance targets, meaningful convenience gain and willingness to switch shade/formula/price.
Manufacturing fit, supplier qualification, minimum order and economics.
Matched alternative suitability, finished-product wear, safety and stability.

reuse.decision: No repository port or paper/ingredient scoring imported.
reuse.rationale: Current task concerns package loading and a few directly accessible primary sources. Ingredient identity or bibliographic-score helpers cannot establish package compatibility or finished performance. Existing source fingerprints, discovery selection and provenance validation are reused.

budget.counting: Ten new distinct technical documents including one inaccessible older catalogue, plus one reused patent. Abstract and timed-out PDF are the same article; repeated requests and search listings add no documents. The bounded technical pass is complete.
